statement.excerpt: As of writing this sentence, Anthropic’s availability for its Claude Chatbot has 98.79% uptime, its platform/console is at 99.14%, its API is at 99.09%, and Claude Code is at 99.25% for the last 90 days.

our_interpretation: Test the four displayed service-level uptime percentages, rounded to two decimal places, for the same rolling 90-day window.
Use the publication date as the approximate observation date, placing the window between January 21 and April 21, 2026. The writing timestamp is unknown.
The surrounding four-nines comparison does not establish that 99.99% is a universal industry standard and is not part of this numerical assessment.
criteria.support_condition: A dated Anthropic status-page snapshot, or a reproducible reconstruction using its component definitions and uptime calculation, shows all four quoted percentages for the relevant window.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An equivalent record for the same observation time and rolling window shows materially different percentages. Different snapshots or isolated incidents do not suffice.
